sources.title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery

inspection_spans.observation: Deep and Wide Research tasks require full-text, multi-step, open-ended literature discovery; strong agents score below ten percent on the reported metrics.
Ground truth uses full-text multi-model verification plus domain-expert audits with a precision-triggered re-review loop.
Manual auditing checks extra retrievals; observed failures include constraint relaxation, tool execution, evidence aggregation, and termination/state tracking.

sources.supports: Evidence that polished search output can conceal constraint, verification, tool, and evidence-state failures.
sources.does_not_establish: End-to-end scientific quality, human learning, or superiority of one research-process protocol.

sources.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement

inspection_spans.observation: A persistent hypothesis tree links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across autonomous optimization tasks.
Reported gains are measured on fixed task-native objectives and held-out evaluations; the operational setting removes step-level human supervision.
The evidence concerns six optimization tasks and does not establish human learning or broad scientific validity.

sources.supports: A persistent-tree mechanism for cumulative autonomous research and preserved failed branches.
sources.does_not_establish: That this process improves human understanding, scientific validity, or open-ended topic choice.

sources.title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents

inspection_spans.observation: HEP argues that existing agents and humans cannot readily trace hypotheses, tests, and belief changes, and externalizes them as persistent auditable objects.
The registry is append-only and event-sourced; evidence-driven refinement preserves parent states and rejects invalid lifecycle moves.
Experiments use one autonomous materials-research agent without human input under a bounded setup.

sources.supports: An auditable hypothesis/evidence/belief protocol and append-only lifecycle mechanism.
sources.does_not_establish: Human learning benefits, calibrated belief truth, or transfer beyond the tested materials-science tasks.
